title: Oxidation of diglycerol to diglycerose using hydrogen peroxide as a clean oxidant
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,3088-3094
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00141B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanfang Qin, Huan Wang, Estelle Métay, Nicolas Duguet
This study focuses on the preparation of diglycerose from biobased diglycerol using hydrogen peroxide as a clean oxidant. The conversion of diglycerose to other platform molecules was also investigated.
